messages.author: 6ca62a5f409b469f
messages.subject: Re: How to execute a secondary R script completely using the action button in SHINY?
parts:
Hello,
One approach I can imagine to do this is: put a `source` call in an `observeEvent` expression [1]. That would cause your script to be evaluated run on button press.

Separately, if necessary, you could use `reactiveFileReader` to monitor the CSV file and update the UI when it has been changed, if this is something you also want to happen.

Alan

1. http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/action-buttons.html
2. https://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/reactiveFileReader.html
